2.7.1 | Verify that clear text out of band (NIST "restricted") authenticators, such as SMS or PSTN, are not offered by default, and stronger alternatives such as push notifications are offered first.
-- | --

2.2.2 | [MODIFIED] Verify that weak authenticators (such as out-of-band authentication using VOIP or email) are not used as authentication methods. Verify that restricted authenticators (those using PSTN to deliver OTPs via phone or SMS) are offered only when alternate stronger methods are also offered and when the service provides information on their security risks to users.
-- | --

Can I add a question here about level. Both requirements are L1. Does it mean it concerns Single factor authentication as well as Second factor? Could you please correct me if I'm wrong with following statements:

1. If the app requires only one factor and it is password - both requirements are met?
2. If the app allows login with some TOTP from Authentication App (such as google auth app OR Microsoft auth app) - the requirements are met?
3. If the app allows login with SMS only - the requirements are NOT met
4. If the app requires MFA , first factor is password, second is auth app TOTP  OR SMS - the requirements are met
5. If the app requires MFA , first factor is password, second is only SMS  - the requirements are NOT met

Sorry to skip the Alena's questions, but the requirement [2.2.2](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x11-V2-Authentication.md#v22-general-authenticator-security) is newer and has updated 2.7.1, so I think 2.7.1 should be deleted.
